title: Môi giới vay phải làm gì cho bạn?

subtitles.text: Under Australian law, mortgage brokers must act in your interests.
It's called the BID, and it applies every time a broker helps you with consumer credit, including a home loan.
They must understand your situation and goals, treat cost as a priority, and usually show you more than one option.
They must also explain why a recommendation suits you, and tell you about government schemes you may be eligible for.
If there is a conflict of interest, your interests must come before the broker's.
And no contract or disclaimer can take this duty away.
Questions about your loan? Message Finance Hub for help.
